scenario: [LNLS.3.3], two singletons: 'between two singletons, no equality is required'. Each side holds at most one live fact, so the join is at most one pair with no anchor at all. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate.lnls_3_3_anchors`, the singleton arm with both sides empty-keyed; requiring an equality here turns this red with DS_VALIDATE_NOLINSCAN_JOIN_ANCHOR_C.
rules_ds:
use default:
    linear_scan: false

schema Cpu scope logical:
    pcf: Int mutable

schema Ir scope logical:
    op: Int mutable

rule decode:
    Cpu cpu
    Ir ir where ir.op > cpu.pcf
->
    log info "decode"
